text:
Random question — hoping someone here has experience with this!
I’m flying to Israel from the UK next week. I’ve been invited by Misrad HaPnim to come to get for my first B/1 visa. 

I’m an electrician and I’d like to bring my hand tools with me in my checked luggage, but I’m a little nervous because I’ll initially be entering Israel on a tourist visa.

Has anyone been in a similar situation or knows whether there could be an issue with bringing professional hand tools through customs/border control? I’d really appreciate hearing about your experience or any advice! 🙏
